in_marathi.name: Karmveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karmveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'duty-bound hero' or 'warrior of duty.' In Hindu mythology, the term 'karma' signifies the moral force generated by actions, and 'veer' represents a hero or warrior. Thus, Karmveer symbolizes an individual who valiantly performs their duties, often with selfless devotion and courage.
